_doc: Elites (0.3.3): an existing monster plus one or more words, Diablo-style, using the player's own keyword vocabulary. The monster keeps its own behaviour; each word adds one trait. base applies to every elite. patrols and ley_waves say when they appear and how many words they roll. Numbers are first-pass, deliberately large; tune freely. Element words do something: FIERY throws fireballs, ICY bursts frost when you are close, SHOCKING calls a warned lightning strike on you, IRON is armoured; each touch also puts its status on you (player_statuses). Their spells are data/spells/elite_*.json, cast through the same spell engine as yours. Ley guardians, bosses, more cast words and learning a word from a defeated elite are later work (doc 15).

player_statuses._doc: Statuses monsters put on the player (elite contact and elite spells). Slows stack as the strongest one.
